missionDesc.title: Our goal is to give you a new set of skills for working in the film industry. After our seminars you will be able to:
missionDesc.text1: Professionally stage stage fights no matter how complicated
missionDesc.text2: Mittevo adapts to the director's ability on a significant Maidan
missionDesc.text3: Control your body in extreme minds
missionDesc.text4: Ensure the safety of yourself and your partners while playing tricks,
missionDesc.text5: Create visual scenes, which look realistic on camera

block2.title: After a series of seminars, you will experience a new dimension of body and mind

block3.desc1: Seminars are a quantum leap into the world of your own possibilities. In a minimum of time you will reveal the multifaceted creative personality that has been dormant inside, find your superpowers and turn them into a weapon of success.
block3.desc2: This is where a sharp memory, laser attention, boundless imagination and magnetic sociability are born. You will develop unwavering self-confidence that radiates charisma and learn to dance with the chaos of non-standard situations.
block3.desc3: The main thing is that you will master the revolutionary philosophy of the 'Principle of the Game', which turns life into an exciting adventure, where each challenge becomes a new level to pass.
